facts.fact: Kira Studio: native macOS workbench combining visual database client for ten engines with HTTP/gRPC API client; built on Wails (Go) and Vue 3.
Kira Studio has Studio (database), Api, Automations, Docker modes, switched with one button.
Repository also contains sibling app Kira Space: native git client and code workspace with coding agents, memory store, terminal, phone view on home network.
Kira Studio is beta; supports only macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon (arm64), dark mode only.
Kira Studio builds ad-hoc signed, not notarized; each new build counts as different app to Keychain, so first launch after update may prompt for Keychain access (choose Always Allow).
Saved credentials encrypted at rest in macOS Keychain.
Install script downloads latest release's disk image, moves app into /Applications, avoiding Gatekeeper prompt (unlike browser-downloaded DMG).
Install script option --app=space installs Kira Space instead.
Installed app checks GitHub for newer release and offers update, but installs nothing until user clicks Update; silent auto-update deliberately absent.
`bun run package:studio` installs own dependencies (Bun workspace, Go module, pinned wails3 CLI); outputs apps/kira-studio/bin/Kira Studio.app and Kira Studio.dmg.
Locally built app has not gone through installer, so first launch needs Gatekeeper workaround (right-click Open, or remove com.apple.quarantine attribute with xattr).
Supported engines: PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL (8.0.16+), SQLite, ClickHouse, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, SQS, S3.
ClickHouse writes insert only; Redis writes cover string keys, with delete on any type; Kafka supports produce; SQS supports send and delete; S3 supports writes plus upload/download.
Stop cancels operation itself (pg_cancel_backend, KILL QUERY, cursor abort, consumer stop), not only its display.
SQS never polls on its own; reads happen only when user presses Poll, because ReceiveMessage hides messages from real consumers.
Each connection has read-only guard enforced in backend and optional pre-connect script such as port-forward.
Update credentials on saved connection changes only its username and password.
Session restore reopens tabs without auto-connecting.
SQL edits staged as pending change set with exact command preview; nothing reaches database until commit. Document, key/value and stream writes apply immediately.
Column masking (PII) display-only, six masks; underlying data never changed.
Query console SQL completions, diagnostics, hovers come from DDL document user pastes in.
Kira Studio caching three-tier, no speculative prefetch.
Touch ID or system password confirmation required before revealing saved password.
Kira Studio Automations smart script: prompt run by headless Claude Code, with typed parameters, model, budget, timeout, tick list of allowed tools and MCP servers.
Recurring Kira Studio automation scripts use cron schedule; due run asks confirmation by default; missed run never replayed.
Remote tcp:// Docker engine without TLS works, but Kira Studio UI flags it as insecure.
Kira Studio Api client keeps last 30 responses per request in response history.
